column1: # Subjective per-tile include/exclude decisions for Connecticut squadrats.
# The geometric clip (state or town polygons) cannot settle every border tile.
# This file overrides it. One row per tile; the vote always wins.
#   include = 1  force the tile INTO Connecticut
#   include = 0  force the tile OUT of Connecticut
# center_lat/center_lon and note are for humans only - nothing reads them back.
# To find the tile for a point:  python squadrats.py --at LAT LON
